narrative: 一个方形的世界发现自己可以变宽。一幅遮幅宽银幕画面突然置身于一个更高的画框里。
画框本身就是一个角色。当一个时代、一种自由，或一种束缚应当被感受为整部电影的边界时使用它。
对于变焦来说，这就用错了工具，它也不是画面内部的一个遮罩。如果只是镜头收紧，容器本身从未改变。
如果一个钥匙孔安置在一个稳定的16:9画框内，那是遮罩（Masking）。
how: 为两种画幅比例分别构图出安全区域，为裁切或侧边遮幅做动画处理。
保持主体的几何形态不变，人物不能被拉伸变形去填满新的画框。
摄影机可以保持锁定，事件本身就是这个边界的变化。
提示词：an aspect-ratio switch on the subject: the frame itself widening or closing。对于视频，在这段序列中呈现一次可见的裁切或展开过程。
when: 用在一个角色把世界向外推开，或者一个新的时代应当拥有一个不同画框的那个瞬间。不要把它当作只改变镜头景别的一次变焦拉远。
vs: 遮罩（Masking）在一个稳定的容器内部切出一个形状；画幅切换则是改变容器本身。
全景（Wide Shot）是在你既有的画幅比例内选择的一种景别；改变画幅比例并不等同于用镜头拉得更广。
examples_film: 《妈咪》（Mommy）让史蒂夫看起来把一个受限的画框向外推开；《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）为不同的叙事时代分配不同的画框形状。
《欲罪》（Ozark）和泽维尔·多兰（Xavier Dolan）的其他电影使用同样的“容器即事件”语法。这不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是变焦和拉伸。破绽是身体被拉宽以填满新的画框，或者镜头猛地推近却没有遮幅的变化。
解决办法是一次裁切或展开，露出更多画面，同时保持几何比例不变。

faq.q: 电影中的画幅切换是什么？
faq.a: 画幅切换改变画面可见的边界，让容器变宽或变窄。它标志着时间、视角或可能性上的一次转变，画面本身不会被拉伸变形。

faq.q: 画幅切换 vs 遮罩
faq.a: 遮罩在画面内部放置一个形状；画幅切换改变的是整部电影的外部边界。一个是一个洞，另一个是一个全新的框。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用画幅切换？
faq.a: 当容器本身应当参与叙事时使用它：时代的变化、突如其来的自由、一种习得的束缚被打开。如果你只需要一个更广的镜头或一个更紧的特写，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写画幅切换的提示词？
faq.a: 写下 "Aspect-ratio switch on [Subject], the frame widening or closing"。说明两种画幅比例，要求呈现裁切或展开过程，而不是变焦，并且不要拉伸人物的身体。

narrative: A square world learns it can become a wide one. A scope picture suddenly sits in a taller box.
The frame is a character. Use it when a period, a freedom, or a constraint should be felt as the edge of the movie.
It is the wrong tool for a zoom, and it is not a mask inside the picture. If the lens merely tightens, the container never changed.
If a keyhole sits inside a stable 16:9, that is masking.
how: Compose protected areas for both ratios. Animate the crop or the side mattes.
Preserve subject geometry. Bodies must not squash to fill the new frame.
The camera may be locked. The event is the bounds.
Prompt an aspect-ratio switch on the subject: the frame itself widening or closing. For video, a visible crop or reveal during the sequence.
when: Use it for the beat when a character pushes the world open, or when a new time period deserves a different box. Do not use it as a zoom-out that only changes shot size.
vs: Masking cuts a shape inside a stable container. A ratio switch changes the container.
Wide Shot is a shot size inside whatever ratio you already have. Switching ratio is not going wider with the lens.
examples_film: Mommy lets Steve appear to open a constrained frame outward. The Grand Budapest Hotel assigns different narrative periods different frame shapes.
Ozark and other Xavier Dolan films use the same container-as-event grammar. Not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousins are a zoom and a stretch. The tell is the body fattening to fill the new box, or the lens punching in with no matte move.
The fix is a crop or reveal of extra picture, geometry preserved.

faq.q: What is a ratio switch in film?
faq.a: A ratio switch changes the visible boundaries of the image, widening or closing the container. It marks a shift in time, viewpoint, or possibility. The picture is not stretched.
Masking puts a shape inside the picture. A ratio switch changes the outer bounds of the movie. One is a hole. The other is a new box.

faq.q: When should I use a ratio switch?
faq.a: Use it when the container should act: a period change, a sudden freedom, a learned restriction opening. Skip it when you only need a wider lens or a tighter close-up.

faq.q: How do I prompt a ratio switch for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Aspect-ratio switch on [Subject], the frame widening or closing. Name both ratios. Demand a crop or reveal, not a zoom, and no stretching of the body.
